Additional comments:
questions.answer: trouble with my registration

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: very complicated because of it trouble.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Online and online helpdesks

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Not all the classes that I wanted were available in the semester I was there.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Pay attention to which courses are offered in the semester you chose.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: need to study a lot because of the many exams and the short amount of time.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Need to study a lot to pass. Don't take the course international police and judicial cooperation.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The teaching style of the courses were very similar to lectures - No dialogue ect - some of the other courses are more similar to "seminar undervisning"

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: International police and judicial cooperation, restorative justice, international criminal law, Cybercrime and Crime Control in a Digitising World, Political Crimes and Transitional Justice, Juvenile Justice and Youth Criminology.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: International criminal law, Cybercrime and Crime Control in a Digitising World were interesting but a lot of work for only 3 ects points. The workload for Restorative justice and Political Crimes and Transitional Justice were more appropriate. I would NOT recommend the course International police and judicial cooperation.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: see Belgium, the Netherlands and other destinations which are reachable by train.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: very easy - belgian culture is quite similar to danish culture

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: not really

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Belgians go home during the weekend.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The love for beer.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: I would stay in a residence. Not take the courses private international law and international police and judicial cooperation, and try to take as many courses as possible with a high amount of ects points. The 3 ects point courses are way to much work for the few amount of credits.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: If you have any courses where the exam is a paper, then try to complete them before the examination period.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Meeting a lot of good people.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: the examination period.

questions.answer: Yes
